Braced Harness

You lean into your armor and let every strap take its share of the strain.

Rules

Action: Reaction · Attribute: Fortitude

Target / range / shape: Self, before Stability is applied to forced movement against you, including when struck in a collision chain

- Weak: Gain Stability 1 for this forced movement. - Standard: Gain Stability 2 for this forced movement. - Strong: Gain Stability 3 for this forced movement.

Use your highest applicable Stability, maximum 3, rather than adding this grant to another source. Apply it once in this chain.

Duration: This forced movement only

Equipment / acquisition: Requires armor.

---

Tier / minimum level: 1 · DP: 2 · Requirements to learn: Armor 1

Type: Skill

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: braced-harness
